name: ritsu
description: The Agent Skills of ritsu, one plugin with a skill for ritsu and one for each of its eight languages.

plugins.name: ritsu
plugins.description: Agent Skills for ritsu and its eight small languages: business rules (rulec), workflows (dandori), dates (koyomi), ledgers (chobo), claims about code (geas), where requirements come from (yuen), maps of bounded contexts (sakai) and who may do what (sekisho). The skills run the ritsu binary, which has to be on PATH.
